gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to retrieve a list of custom field configurations for my project so that I can manage and update them as necessary.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of custom field configurations, including their IDs, names, and associated contexts.

gold.user: As a project manager, I need to get the configuration details of a specific custom field to ensure it meets the requirements of my team.
gold.ideal: The API should return the configuration details of the specified custom field, including its context, options, and any validation rules.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to update the configuration of a custom field to reflect the latest changes in our project requirements.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully update the custom field configuration and return a confirmation message along with the updated configuration details.
